name: CoGeNT
summary: CoGeNT searched for low-mass WIMPs with low-threshold point-contact germanium and reported a low-energy excess and indications of modulation. Their dark-matter interpretation has not been confirmed.
detection_principle: Point-contact electrodes reduce capacitance and noise. Pulse rise time identifies slow surface-charge-collection events before the low-energy ionization spectrum is studied.

key_parameters.value: Particular emphasis on low-mass WIMPs near 10 GeV/c², not its only sensitivity range.

results.summary: CDEX-1 results using similar technology constrain dark-matter models invoked to explain the CoGeNT excess.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
